item.description: Gas prices jumped to $4.39 per gallon after the Iran ceasefire. Gas prices hit $4.39 per gallon in biggest one-day jump since Iran ceasefire announced NBC News.

item.title: Trump Tells US Congress Hostilities In Iran "Have Terminated"
item.description: President Donald Trump told Congress that hostilities in Iran have terminated. President Donald Trump told top US lawmakers on Friday that hostilities in Iran had ended, after coming under pressure from Congress to seek authorization for the conflict as it headed into its third month.

item.title: Israel Said to Have Helped Defend Emirates in Iran War With Iron Dome
item.description: Israel reportedly helped defend the UAE with its Iron Dome missile defense system during the Iran war. The Emirates bore the brunt of Iran's retaliatory attacks on Gulf countries. It appeared to be the first time the missile defense system was sent to an Arab country.

item.title: Lebanon says 12 killed in Israeli strikes on southern town
item.description: Israeli strikes killed 12 people in southern Lebanon, despite a ceasefire and evacuation warnings. Lebanon said Israeli strikes killed 12 people in the south, including in a town under an evacuation warning despite a ceasefire.

item.description: Israeli attacks on Lebanon killed at least 12, with over 2,600 dead since March 2. Israel's strikes continue, with more than 2,600 killed since March 2, despite an ongoing ceasefire.

item.title: Trump tells Congress ceasefire means he does not need their approval for Iran war
item.description: US President Trump claims congressional approval is no longer needed for a war with Iran, citing a ceasefire as proof hostilities have terminated. He made the statement in a letter to Congress on 10 April 2026.

item.title: Iranian Nobel laureate Narges Mohammadi hospitalised as health deteriorates
item.description: Iranian Nobel laureate Narges Mohammadi was hospitalized after losing consciousness twice. Mohammadi has lost consciousness twice and suffered a severe cardiac crisis, her foundation has announced. Iranian Nobel laureate Narges Mohammadi hospitalised as health deteriorates.

item.description: President Trump expressed dissatisfaction with Iran's proposal to end the war. The details of the latest plan were unclear, and President Trump did not specify his objections. Trump ‘Not Satisfied’ With Iran’s Proposal on Ending War.

item.title: Judge protects Yemeni refugees, slams Trump administration’s push to end special status
item.description: A judge protected Yemeni refugees, blocking the Trump administration's push to end their special status. Amid its immigration crackdown, the Trump administration has terminated Temporary Protected Status for people from nine countries, including Haiti, Venezuela and Ethiopia.

item.title: Cuban man is 18th person to die in US ICE custody this year: Monitor
item.description: A Cuban man died in US ICE custody, the 18th death this year. Rights group says believed suicide underscores need for more oversight amid Trump's mass deportation drive. Cuban man is 18th person to die in US ICE custody this year: Monitor.

item.title: Trump says 'not satisfied' with new Iran proposal sent through Pakistan
item.description: The US administration has declared its war in Iran terminated, 60 days before a deadline to seek congressional approval. The decision comes after a ceasefire was brokered in the region.

item.title: US judge bars Trump from ending protected status for Yemeni nationals
item.description: A US judge has blocked the Trump administration from ending protected status for Yemeni nationals, part of a broader immigration crackdown. The administration had sought to cancel temporary protections for 13 countries.

item.title: Suspect in UK Stabbing Attack on Jewish Men Faces Third Attempted Murder Charge
item.description: A man faces attempted murder charges for stabbing two Jewish men in London. A man appeared in court charged with the attempted murder of two Jewish men in Golders Green, in north London, and of another man, an acquaintance, elsewhere in the city.

item.title: Rebel checkpoints reported around Mali’s capital, northern town seized
item.description: Rebel groups seized a northern town in Mali and set up checkpoints. JNIM and Tuareg separatists continue their attacks against Mali's military government. Rebel checkpoints reported around Mali’s capital, northern town seized.

item.title: Can Iran withstand the US naval blockade?
item.description: The US has imposed a naval blockade on Iran to cut off its oil exports. The Trump administration aims to force Iran into concessions through economic pressure. The Trump administration is trying to force Iran into concessions by cutting off its oil exports.
